snippet.title: The Hambagu Shop – Release Date Trailer | PC, PS5, Nintendo Switch & Xbox Series X|S
snippet.description:
The Hambagu Shop launches on January 11, 2027.

WISHLIST NOW
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3991140/The_Hambagu_Shop/
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/ja-jp/concept/10018736

Run a Japanese Hamburg steak restaurant, serve delicious meals, grow your business, and uncover the disturbing secrets hiding behind its cozy atmosphere.

The Hambagu Shop is a cozy horror simulator where everyday restaurant life slowly turns into something far more unsettling.
